title: The Night the Ink Went Home
description: After the last printing of the year, the blue ink slips off the pages, gathers itself into a manta ray, and glides back to its jar.
alt: A translucent cobalt manta ray formed from wet ink glides above printing sheets toward a ceramic inkwell beside a lit oil lamp.
pairing: Year-end printers’ holiday × a manta ray made of returning ink
